🏛️ Overview

📌 QualiTor is a software design project focused on creating quality manuals based on the MoProSoft model.

📌 The design emphasizes structured templates, process mapping, and clear documentation workflows.

🩷 Features

💻 Software Design: A software design project focused on creating quality manuals.

🧩 MoProSoft Model: Based on the MoProSoft model for quality manual creation.

🗂️ Structured Templates: Emphasizes the use of structured templates for organization.

🔄 Process Mapping: Includes process mapping capabilities for visualizing workflows.

📝 Documentation Workflows: Ensures clear and efficient documentation workflows.
